blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— Government agencies and conservation stakeholders gathered in Calintaan town in Occidental Mindoro on Wednesday (Oct. 7) for the this year’s Tamaraw Festival, highlighting efforts to protect the endangered tamaraw, the animal symbol of Mindoro. The festival was held as part of the province’s observance of Tamaraw Month, intending to raise awareness about the need to conserve the species and its habitat. The activity began with a motorcade from Station 1 of the Mount Iglit-Baco National Park to the Calintaan Municipal Gymnasium, where the main festival program was held.
